notes.title: Small Improvements - V15 (2)
notes.notes:
This update has some small fixes and improvements.
- XP orb visuals are a bit different, hopefully much better visual clarity and less clutter.
- Dione's magical dress is reworked, can now store XP and be activated by holding DOWN.

notes.title: V15 Update - Diamonds, 3 New weapons & 4 new artifacts!
notes.notes:
[h1][h2]Patch V15[/h2][/h1]
[h3]New Diamond Currency [/h3]
A new valuable diamond currency that can be used to unlock weapons and artifacts.
Get diamonds from boss enemies that spawns at 460 meters on each world. There is currently only one boss.
You can only get one diamond per character per world.

[h3]Gleaming Orb[/h3]
A basic magic weapon that deals bonus damage to undead enemies

[h3]Throwing Axe[/h3]
A throwing axe that returns to your hand

[h3]Cyan Magic[/h3]
This is a kind of "support" weapon. It has lower damage, but gives damage amp while it is held and refunds mana on hit.

[h3]Mobility Boots[/h3]
Bronze Artifact that gives more movement speed and slightly more jump height

[h3]Weighted Vest[/h3]
Silver Artifact that gives a lot of damage, but you are heavier and become slower with less powerful jumps

[h3]Omnistone[/h3]
Gold Artifact that gives a decent bonus to various stats every 8 levels

[h3]Hexed Potion[/h3]
Silver Artifact that gives a lot of damage and area, but your mana costs are doubled

[h3]Power Level UI[/h3]
This is a number in the bottom left corner that is an estimate of how powerful you are. It will update and show the differences whenever you gain or lose power. It does not take into account everything, only the most basic stats.
Unlocked from the "Djenneee Beginner" achievement

[h3]Ect[/h3]
- New zoom option, you can now zoom the view from 100%-130%.
- I updated all achievement icons to show something related to the achievement requirements instead of showing the achievement reward.
- Many UI elements now have a smooth shadow
- The purple snake enemy in Djenneee previously started walking through walls when above the player, now they become a ghost/spectre that will float down until they are below the player.
- 1 less miniboss enemy on each run, but golden and shadow enemies have slightly less HP.
- Various smaller rebalancing changes.

notes.title: V14 Update, 2 New Characters!
notes.notes:
[h1][h2]Patch V14[/h2][/h1]

[h3]- Dione (New Character) + Magic Dress Artifact [/h3]
Wears a magical dress that conjures various magical attacks when collecting XP orbs
Unlocked from the [b]Slayer 1[/b] Achievement (Nate Bones is now unlocked by default)

[h3]- Octer (New Character) + Tentacle Artifact [/h3]
Has a tentacle hand which can hold an extra weapon, gains another after 270 meters
Also gains 40% reduced mana costs
Unlocked from the new [b]Slayer 3[/b] Achievement

- Updated [b]Duets Charm[/b] to gain 40% reduced mana costs, now using 2 weapons does not cost nearly as much mana as before.

- Changed the values on [b]Mana Potion[/b] and now also gains 20% reduced mana costs.

- New permanent upgrade [b]Mana Regeneration[/b] unlocked from the start

Various smaller changes too small to note

notes.title: First Public Release (V13)
notes.notes:
This is the first ever release of the game, the game currently has:
- 11 Weapons
- 36 Artifacts
- 25 Achievements
- 4 Characters
- 5 Worlds
- 6 Meta Upgrades
- 14 Enemies
- 6 Minibosses

I am planning on updating the game a lot in the future, adding more content.
